title: City pin (3D)
description: A seeded low-poly city: the camera tilts from top-down to an angled view, a location pin drops with a bounce on a highlighted building, walking-radius rings expand and amenity labels appear. For real-estate and location reels.

title.description: Headline; wrap words in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

subline.default: Invented city · walking times are examples
subline.description: Line at the bottom. Say where real walking times come from.

minutes.description: 1-4 walking-time rings in minutes. Radii are proportional to each other (not to a real map scale).

labels.description: Amenities {name, minutes, angle}: placed at the ring distance for its minutes, angle in degrees (0 = right, 90 = away from the viewer).

seed.description: Seed for the city layout. Same seed, same city.

pinStart.description: Second the pin drops; rings and labels follow it.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: walking times come from a real source (or are marked as examples)
amenity labels do not overlap each other or the subline
